---
name: Documentation or licensing correction
about: Report an error, omission, or inconsistency in documentation or licensing
title: "[Docs/License]: "
---

## Type of correction

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Licensing

## Location

Provide the file path, URL, section, or line reference.

## Current content

Quote or describe the content that needs correction.

## Proposed correction

Provide the corrected wording or describe the required change.

## Rationale

Explain why the correction is needed. For licensing corrections, include the applicable license or policy reference when available.

## Additional context

Add supporting links or other relevant details.
